items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: Clive Clark and all the players, you know. He got a good band, too.

ctx.x: Larry, Larry's got, Larry's syncopated. He got a good band, too. Oh, yeah. Clive Clark and all the players, you know. He got a good band, too. And boy, it appears to be good with the good fellas. And one thing along with musicians, all the boys I know, they can all say a good word for me when I try to do right towards all of them. When you try to do all the right things with all them boys, you get along with them all better. And they have a good- I can get any musician in town, I'll say, you know. All right. stuff
